prerequisites: Basic technical knowledge in an engineering context

learning_outcomes.text: Students can categorize typical project management risks.
Students can name solution examples for typical problems in projects.
Students develop solutions or solution approaches for sub-tasks of the project topic within given deadlines.
Students can analyze complex problem structures in the project.
Students know the mechanisms of information retrieval.
Students apply various specialized and advanced procedures, competencies, techniques, and materials to thoroughly solve the problem.
Students apply standard and advanced methods and procedures to solve the task. They use or create data to evaluate it and address the goals of the task.
Students can communicate assumed knowledge and contexts to a specialized audience.
Students are able to work in an international team.

syllabus_topics: Task analysis and definition of goals
Technical and economic evaluation of selected solutions
assessment_rules: The graded assessment consists of a project report (50 - 100 pages) and two presentations during the semester, each 30 minutes long for each project team.
